categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/node/txorphanage.{cpp,h} to resolve an assertion abort in orphan eviction resource accounting, carrying the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion abort in TxOrphanage caused by integer division yielding zero when peer count exceeds 3,000. As noted in the description, integer division gives each peer an allowance of zero when orphan announcements exceed the global threshold, causing LimitOrphans() to crash the node; while serious, this requires non-default configuration well above the standard connection limit.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to orphanage_tests.cpp and txorphan.cpp purely provide test coverage for the P2P orphan fix rather than modifying test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Tests category covers general test framework and harness machinery; domain-specific tests belong solely to the area they verify.
